1) the latency of black box services varies significantly, even when the service is running normally, 2) the variations in latency are correlated with the variations in the network conditions, 3) the variations in the latency of the same service are correlated with the latency variations of other services, 4) the variations in service latency are correlated with service load, 5) the variations in network conditions, and service load, are correlated with the service latency.

latency variations can be explained in terms of a few factors: (1) the workload, (2) the service, and (3) the network.
